name: wardens_of_the_cycle_morbid_gain_then_quiet_turn
note: Wardens of the Cycle: 'Morbid -- At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, choose one -- * You gain 2 life. * You draw a card and you lose 1 life.' Turn 1: the opponent's Bear dies (any creature counts); at P0's end step P0 chooses the first mode and gains 2 (22). Turn 2 is the opponent's: no trigger at its end step. Turn 3: no creature dies, so nothing triggers at P0's end step (no mode is asked; life stays 22). P0 declines every attack.
